justification: New CI workflow that deploys the Railway API service after merges to main. Not Critical: it only starts the deploy Railway should have started; no code path served to users changes. Not Minor: it triggers production deploys.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if an existing deployment is duplicated, a missing one is not started, a failed deploy passes, or a missing token passes.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Railway API on 2026-10-29: no deployments for #1545/#1548 commits; serviceInstanceDeployV2 deployed d3350f17 (982940fc, SUCCESS).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The live gap (two merged PRs undeployed) is the observed failure; the tests pin each path.

pre_impl.existing_data: Railway trigger: branch main, watch services/**, checkSuites false; other 8 services deployed the same commits.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Settings looked correct yet no deployment was created for the API service.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Existing scripts only read Railway state; this is the first that triggers a deploy.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Railway API error raises; the job fails red.

functions.name: main
functions.what: Watch or start the API deployment for this commit and wait.
functions.if_none: Missing token or sha exits 1, never 0.
functions.edge_cases: a SKIPPED deployment for the sha is ignored and a new one started

functions.name: existing_deployment
functions.what: Finds Railway's own deployment for this commit.
functions.input: token and the commit sha string
functions.if_none: No match returns None so one is started.

break_it.scenario: Railway auto-deploy works again for this service
break_it.what_happens: The job only watches Railway's own deployment

break_it.scenario: Railway auto-deploy stays broken for this service
break_it.what_happens: The job starts the deployment itself

break_it.scenario: The build or start fails on Railway

verified: Live run on d3350f17: found the existing deployment, exit 0, nothing started
gaps: Root cause on Railway's side unknown; this works around it and makes it visible

post_merge.action: Watch the first deploy-api run on the next merge that touches services/
post_merge.manual_verify: Actions tab: deploy-api green and the live endpoint reflects the merge
